description: This file declares the interface for the 'tasklet' module in the lighttpd server, defining structures, function prototypes, and callback types for managing tasklets and thread pools within the event loop.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new tasklet pool for managing concurrent tasks within a specific event loop, with configurable thread count.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_free
methods.description: Blocks until all tasklets in the pool have completed and then frees the pool resources.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_set_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads used by the tasklet pool, possibly stopping the old pool and waiting for ongoing tasks to finish.

methods.name: li_tasklet_pool_get_threads
methods.description: Returns the current number of threads used by the tasklet pool.

methods.name: li_tasklet_push
methods.description: Enqueues a tasklet with associated run and finished callbacks to be executed within the pool.
